scope: Authored region stories anchored to generated biomes; links and named places are plans, not walkable paths or spawned objects.

story.name: Reedhaven Vale
story.description: Willow lanterns shelter clay roads between orchard walls and the old river keep.
story.travelNote: The local realm contains the tested Willowglass crossing.

story.name: Barrow Meadow
story.description: Wind-bent flowers trace burial ridges; shepherds hang bronze bells above the hollow lanes.
story.travelNote: Ridge trails and graveyard gates are proposed content.

story.name: Moonroot Elderwood
story.description: Pale roots lace the forest floor around a library whose shelves were carved into living wood.
story.travelNote: Root passages and woodland settlements are proposed.

story.name: Ashfen Mire
story.description: Moth lamps mark abandoned ferry posts above peat pools and slow, reflective water.
story.travelNote: Mothlight crossing geometry exists in the offline preview; this regional placement is planning.

story.name: Saffron Dominion
story.description: Red dunes gather against sandstone courts where shadow lines preserve the hours of a vanished kingdom.
story.travelNote: Saffron crossing geometry exists in the offline preview; desert routes remain planning.

story.name: Glass Oasis
story.description: Palm courts open onto mirror canals, salt-bright coves and gardens cooled by porous stone.
story.travelNote: Canals, coastline activities and boat routes are proposed.

story.name: Cloudbreak Heights
story.description: Mountain terraces hold tiny gardens below rope bridges and wind-polished monastery roofs.
story.travelNote: Cliff traversal needs dedicated route and fall rules.

story.name: Aurora Expanse
story.description: Stone rings rise from blue-white drifts, guiding winter caravans toward a silent ice harbor.
story.travelNote: Winter travel and ice behavior are proposed.

story.name: Emberfall Caldera
story.description: Obsidian walls frame geothermal gardens where warm rain gathers under copper-colored steam.
story.travelNote: Hazards and geothermal gameplay are proposed.

story.name: Luminous Underdeep
story.description: Crystal pillars illuminate fungal courtyards and a buried archive of river-shaped inscriptions.
story.travelNote: Current cavern biome is a heightfield theme, not a subterranean level.
